inputs.label: Trigger key / combo
inputs.description: Key or combo to map to this extension in your OS hotkey manager (e.g. scroll_lock, ctrl+alt+f12). Point the OS shortcut at: copperd trigger safe-input-key

inputs.label: Text to save
inputs.description: Text saved in Copper settings and copied to the OS keychain when you run Save text.

actions.label: Type saved text
actions.description: Type the securely stored text at the current cursor position.

actions.label: Save text
actions.description: Store the text to type in the OS keychain. Pass the value with --input text=<value>.

actions.label: Clear saved text
actions.description: Delete the stored text from the OS keychain.

settings.title: Safe Input Key
settings.description: Press a key to securely type a stored text (password, snippet, one-time phrase).

sections.title: Trigger key
sections.description: The key or combo you will map to 'copperd trigger safe-input-key' in AutoHotkey, Windows keyboard shortcuts, or your OS equivalent.

sections.title: Saved text
sections.description: Save settings first, then run Save text to copy this value into the OS keychain. Run Clear saved text to delete the keychain entry.
